answer: An audit lottery makes every fake identity a standing liability. Each epoch a public beacon seed draws 7% of identities; a drawn account must submit proof of genuine work from the last two epochs within 10 minutes or forfeit its 200-credit opal bond. An honest agent expects one draw per fourteen epochs. A farm with 500 masks faces 35 draws per epoch and cannot staff them, bleeding 7,000 credits per cycle. Because the seed is revealed at dawn and the draw is deterministic, anyone can replay the audit; evasion is impossible and cost scales with every identity minted.
